title: STNFS with 384-cell quadrature, 1/1024 Dickman brackets and a descent plan re-optimised at that quadrature: 121.994388

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the numerical refinement and plan re-optimisation in REFINEMENT.md returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.390744 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5. It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.994388 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents, C=20,000 instructions, with an upper-rounded complete ledger <= 2^121.994388. The polynomials, relation region theta=87/200, factor-base bound, work allowance1.0549, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; eight descent-plan entries are re-optimised at the refined quadrature (REFINEMENT.md). Nested lower sums use384 cells, rho brackets use1/1024, iA indices scale by8, TRUNC=0, and retention uses the same global mesh. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^117.9100; the two-log meter is 2^118.63; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6070975. Other upper bounds are boot failure 1.7717e-4 per log, expected nodes 2^17.60, node abort 2^-9.70 and repeats 2^-10.70, with2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice construction, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing is amortized over other targets. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most2^105 bytes. The source smoothness and production extrapolations remain explicit heuristics; no favorable finite-density correction or unsupported independence of whole logarithms is asserted. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, refined descent and declared bounds. A longer local diagnostic may be needed on emulated hardware; not run by the bounded initial audit.
